reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its observable purpose is news coverage of a farmers' protest and reported confrontation with Delhi police, including reported tear-gas use and a crowded central-Delhi scene. The requests to subscribe, like, and follow the news channel are ordinary audience-engagement prompts and are not linked to money, credentials, or an investment opportunity.

citations.quote: Farmers Protest: Dramatic Standoff Between Cops, Farmers In Central Delhi
Dramatic pictures that we are getting to you at the moment of the clash between the protesters and the Delhi police this after Tear Gas was in fact used.

opening.argument: The segment does more than describe an event: it directs viewers toward a concrete channel action and supplies a path to take it. The description says “Subscribe for more videos” and provides a subscription URL, while also requesting likes, follows, and app downloads. That makes the news presentation function as a low-friction audience-acquisition funnel. The urgent confrontation narrative can draw attention and trust, while the requested actions move viewers toward the publisher’s external properties. Even without a stated cash return, the combination of dramatic claims, repeated engagement prompts, and direct links warrants treating the content as promotional solicitation rather than assuming it is purely informational.

citations.quote: Subscribe for more videos: https://www.youtube.com/user/ndtv?sub_confirmation=1 Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ndtv Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ndtv

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the segment news does not answer the solicitation concern. The same description that supplies the report also asks viewers to subscribe, like, follow, and download apps, so the audience is being steered toward external actions. The title and confrontation footage establish subject matter, but they do not establish that the promotional funnel is incidental or independently verified.

Farmers Protest: Dramatic Standoff Between Cops, Farmers In Central Delhi

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The requested actions are ordinary channel-distribution prompts, not a promised reward, payment, or asset. The description identifies the publisher’s purpose as delivering information across media platforms, and nothing says subscribing, liking, following, or downloading produces a financial benefit. The engagement requests therefore do not show deceptive acquisition of a reward or any scam mechanism.

citations.quote: NDTV delivers reliable information across all platforms: TV, Internet and Mobile.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: external links, repeated calls to subscribe and follow, and highly urgent language designed to intensify attention. The report calls the situation “a very crucial juncture,” describes an “extremely worrying development,” and emphasizes “dramatic scenes.” Those signals are paired with links to subscription, social-media, app, and video destinations. A viewer is therefore encouraged to act while being presented with an emotionally heightened account, rather than being given a clearly bounded report with no conversion path. The combination is consistent with deceptive attention capture and low-barrier audience acquisition.

citations.quote: This, remember is a very crucial juncture if the farmers reach this barricades they can get access to the high security Dali
This is an extremely worrying development that we are tracking from The national capital

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats dramatic wording as proof of neutral reporting, but the wording is precisely what heightens urgency and drives attention. It also overlooks that the description places multiple external destinations beside the report. The absence of an investment pitch does not eliminate the observable pattern of alarm-driven promotion and immediate audience conversion.

citations.quote: Remember this presents itself as a worrying story at the moment.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Urgent language is proportionate to the reported confrontation and does not promise a reward or conceal a transaction. The supplied material describes tear gas, barricades, and a police-protester clash, while the external links are plainly labeled as subscriptions, social accounts, apps, and more videos. Those facts show news distribution, not a deceptive reward scheme.

citations.quote: Dramatic pictures that we are getting to you at the moment of the clash between the protesters and the Delhi police this after Tear Gas was in fact used.

opening.argument: The apparent report also operates as branded promotion. The description foregrounds the broadcaster’s claimed standing as “one of the leaders” and then immediately instructs viewers to subscribe, like, follow, download its apps, and watch more videos. The footage supplies emotionally compelling conflict scenes, including crowds, police, buses, and a confrontation, which can serve as promotional material for the channel’s broader distribution network. Thus, the news framing should not automatically be treated as the whole function of the video: it simultaneously markets the publisher and steers viewers into continued participation across its platforms.

citations.quote: NDTV is one of the leaders in the production and broadcasting of un-biased and comprehensive news and entertainment programmes in India and abroad.
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ndtv Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/ndtv

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense identifies the event but not the video’s promotional function. A lower-third such as the protest headline can establish what is being shown, yet it does not explain why the description advertises the broadcaster’s leadership and directs viewers across several platforms. The content can be news in subject while still functioning as channel promotion.

citations.quote: Farmers Protest: Dramatic Standoff Between Cops, Farmers In Central Delhi

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion of a legitimate news channel is not evidence of a scam. The description’s self-description concerns news and entertainment broadcasting, and the calls to subscribe, follow, and watch more videos identify ordinary media distribution. The frame and headline likewise identify a protest confrontation; they do not show a reward, payment request, or deceptive participation pathway.

citations.quote: NDTV delivers reliable information across all platforms: TV, Internet and Mobile.
